installation.note: A disposable profile was created for this build. An initial runtime attempt did not initialize; a second installed all files but lacked a log directory. After explicitly creating log/, installation was repeated only in this disposable profile. RPCS3 logged success and all installed hashes matched. The headless installer reported a manual_typemap teardown diagnostic and its own process was terminated at the time limit. Player profiles, controllers and saves were untouched.
